characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Commanding Presence (12", Sabretooth Tigers).

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Res, and Mountain Hide.
The model automatically fails all Armour Saves and Aegies Saves.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s unit gains First Strike (re-roll to-hit and to-wound rolls of ‘1’).

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Counts as Paired Weapons in Combat, Quick to Fire, Stand and Shoot

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: All Melee Attacks allocated against the target suffer −1 to wound.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model can cast Veil of Mist (Druidism) as a Bound Spell (4+).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A Charging model with this Attribute, or using a weapon with this Attribute, gains the Model Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets (X). For example, a Charging model part with Devastating Charge (+1 Strength, Poison Attacks) gains +1 Strength and Poison Attacks when it is Charging. This rule is cumulative: a model part with several instances of Devastating Charge applies all Attack Attributes and Characteristics modifiers from all of them when Charging.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
AP 0, Breath Attack (Str 4, Flaming Attacks, Flaming Attacks), and Resistance (Flaming Attacks), and automatically fails all Regeneration Saves.
The model can cast Dragon’s Roar (Pyromancy) as a Bound Spell (5+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Enemy units within 12" of one or more Frost Mammoths suffer −3 Agi (to a minimum of 1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During step 1.2 of Pregame Planning (Build an Army), choose one of the following Model Rules, and write your choice on the Army List:
  • First Strike (Fury)
  • Lethal Strike
  • Devastating Charge (+1 Str, +1 AP)

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
Attached and Fearless.
The bearer’s unit gains Unstable (the model may join units without Unstable during Deployment despite having Unstable).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Range 24", Shots 1, Str 4, Ap 2, Quick to Fire and Slow Reload.
After choosing the target, roll a D6 and choose up to that many additional targets, all within 3" of the original target or in contact with a line drawn from the centre of the shooter to the centre of the original target. If a natural ‘6’ is rolled, the shooter is also automatically hit by the weapon. Roll to hit for all other targets as normal. The weapon does not suffer the −1 to-hit modifier from firing multiple shots.
No model can ever gain Weapon Proficiency for Hand Cannons after being recruited.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: At the end of any Round of Combat in which the model part has caused a HP loss on enemy models and did not break from combat, roll a D6: on 3+, the model Recovers 1 HP.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
+1 Arm, Weapon Master, and may not take any Weapon Enchantment.
In addition, the bearer gains the following weapons: Great Weapon, Halberd, Iron Fist, and Paired Weapons.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: March and Shoot, Multiple Wounds (D3, towards Height 5), Quick to Fire

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At Initiative Step 10, a Charging model part with Impact Hits must choose an enemy model in base contact. This model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the attacking model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Melee Weapon
characteristics.$text: +1 Arm against Melee Attacks, +1 Att, and Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy unit performs any of the following actions, it suffers 2D6 hits with Strength 4, Armour Penetration 1, and Unmodifiable:
  • The enemy unit successfully Charges a unit containing It’s a Trap! in contact with a Terrain Feature.
  • The enemy unit comes into contact (while it was not in contact earlier) with a Terrain Feature that is in contact with a unit containing It’s a Trap!. Resolve the hits at the end of the action that triggered them. No unit can be affected by It’s a Trap! more than once in each Player Turn (including from different units containing It’s a Trap!).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The Mammoth Hunter’s base size is changed to 50×50 mm.
The model replaces Exclusive (Yetis) with Exclusive (Sabretooth Tigers).
While joined to a unit of Sabretooth Tigers, the unit gains Vanguard, loses Unruly, and the Mammoth Hunter counts as being of the same Height as the unit for the purposes of allocating Ranged Attacks and Special Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks with Multiple Wounds (X) against the model halve their X value (rounding fractions up).

sharedProfiles.name: Pennant of the Great Grass Sky

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s unit’s Charge Range rolls gain Maximised, and its Flee Distance rolls gain Minimised.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Stomp Attack (D3+1), and all models in its unit must reroll failed to-wound rolls with Stomp Attack.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Att.
While the wielder’s unit is Engaged in Combat, it can cast Hand of Glory (Occultism) as a Bound Spell (4+).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
Immune (Poison Attacks) and Poison Attacks.
Friendly Kin-Eater units may reroll failed Ambush rolls while the bearer is on the Battlefield.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
Commanding Presence (12", Scrapling).
Units with Scrapling property lose Unruly as long as the bearer is on the Battlefield.
As long as the bearer is joined to a unit of Scraplings, its model counts as being of the same Height as its unit for the purpose of allocating Ranged Attacks and Special Attacks.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Devastating Charge (+1 Att, +1 Str, +1 AP).

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Stomp Attack can make a Special Attack which is resolved at Agility Step 0, can only be allocated towards a Health Pool of Height 0–1, and inflicts X hits, using the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons. If more than one model part of a combined model has Stomp Attack, only a single model part (chosen by the model’s owner) can perform its Stomp Attack in each Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: An enemy unit suffers −1 Agi (to a minimum of 1) for each unit containing Touch of Frost it is in contact with.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Poison Attacks (Melee & Shooting).
Shots 4, Str 4, AP 2, and always hits on 4+.
It cannot benefit from Area Attack or Direct Hit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The minimum amount of Army Points that must be spent on Core units is reduced to Min. 20%, and Mammoth Hunters become Common.
The Army List may not include any of the following units: Great Khans, Khans, Bruisers, Bombardiers, Mercenary Veterans, Mercenary Gunners with Brace of Ogre Pistols, or Thunder Cannons.
